author: Inside Edition
description: It looked like a scene from a science-fiction blockbuster, with a large 'spaceship' appearing in L.A.’s Exposition Park. But this is real. It's a museum dedicated to creative storytelling, founded by 'Star Wars' creator George Lucas and businesswoman Melody Hobson. The Lucas Museum of Narrative Art is set to open later this month. Inside Edition's Jim Moret takes us inside.
title: What's This 'Spaceship' That Appeared In Los Angeles?

author: Inside Edition
description: The old song reminds us that "a kiss is just a kiss". But things may not be so simple when it comes to the world of Illinois politics. Steven Landek, a Democratic leader and mayor of the town of Bridgeview, was caught on surveillance camera delivering a smooch to Elyse Hoffenberg, a married woman who is running for Cook County Commissioner. But some are asking if the release of the tape was part of a blackmail attempt.
title: Were Kissing Politicos Caught On Camera Part Of A Blackmail Attempt?

author: Inside Edition
description: The odds of being struck by lightning are less than one in a million, but it happened to New Yorker Thomas Fahmy. Fahmy, who works as a GOP congressional staffer, was walking in the rain when he was hit by a bolt of electricity. He survived, and he tells Inside Edition's Justin Finch it may have been his umbrella that attracted the lightning. The draw-dropping brush with danger was caught on camera.
title: Did Man's Umbrella Cause Him To Get Struck By Lightning?

author: Inside Edition
description: Lynnette Bellin was swimming in Lake Tahoe over the weekend when she was attacked by an unlikely aggressor: an otter. Bellin, who teaches swimming, said the powerful otter tried to pull her underwater. She was able to fend off the attacking animal, but her face was badly scratched in the incident, requiring dozens of stitches. Bellin spoke to Inside Edition's Jim Moret about her terrifyingly close encounter.
title: Swimmer Describes How She Escaped Otter Attack In Lake Tahoe

author: Inside Edition
description: The jury in the Lindsay Clancy case was back at it, for its fifth day of deliberations. There was also unexpected drama outside court as a woman was arrested; she's accused of filming the jurors, which is prohibited. She has denied the allegation and plead not guilty. Inside Edition's Ann Mercogliano caught up with her as she tried to run from reporters outside the courthouse in Plymouth, Massachusetts.
title: Woman Arrested For Allegedly Photographing Lindsay Clancy Jurors

author: Inside Edition
description: Lionel Messi announced his retirement from the Argentine national team this week. Now, one restaurant in his native country is paying homage to the No. 10 with a traditional dish in his honor and likeness by crafting a milanesa, a breaded schnitzel, but this time shaped and decorated to resemble the face of the country's soccer star. Chef Damian Zanotti of Buenos Aires restaurant El Antojo used a photograph of Messi as a reference while shaping the meat, applying egg wash and coating it with breadcrumbs. The restaurant called the creation "La Milamessi.
title: Chef Makes Dish in the Likeness of Lionel Messi as He Retires from the Argentine National Team

author: Inside Edition
description: Dale Sanders refuses to be outdone! That's why he was back on the Appalachian Trail summiting mountains between Georgia and Maine at 91 years old. Sanders, also known as Grey Beard, set a record in 2017, becoming the oldest hiker to complete the Trail. Four years later someone took that title from him, but he vowed to reclaim the honor. After some bad falls, he says he came very close to just missing out. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: 91-Year-Old Becomes Oldest Person To Hike Appalachian Trail Again
